incidents.body: The issue has been fixed, and AI functionality is now working normally.

incidents.body: This issue has been resolved. The cause was an internal change to how our systems renew their access credentials, which left file storage temporarily unreachable. Access was restored automatically at 07:00 UTC and the change has been corrected. Only the EU region was affected. We are sorry for the disruption.
incidents.title: Images and attachments not loading (EU region)
Potential authentication issues with Google Auth on cloud sites

incidents.body: Between 7:30am and 7:44am BST this morning, access to Deskpro was degraded for approximately 14 minutes. The disruption occurred during scheduled infrastructure maintenance, part of our ongoing hardening work following the recent service incident. The maintenance took longer to apply than anticipated. Service was fully restored at 7:44am and all systems are operating normally. No data was lost or affected.
incidents.title: Service disruption during scheduled maintenance

incidents.body: Between approximately 13:36 and 14:15 BST, some customers experienced errors and slow performance when using Deskpro. This was caused by an issue with one of our database servers. Our team identified the affected server and rerouted traffic away from it, restoring normal performance. We've opened an investigation with our infrastructure provider to determine the root cause.
incidents.title: Intermittent errors and slow performance

incidents.body: This issue is now resolved. We have removed the mitigations that were put in place and confirmed normal operation. We'll continue to monitor closely to ensure stability and will provide a further update if anything changes.
incidents.title: Intermittent errors when adding attachments
